basic_details.scholarship_name: Columbia University Presidential Fellowships & Dean's Doctoral Awards
basic_details.offering_entity: Graduate School of Arts and Sciences (GSAS) & Fu Foundation School of Engineering and Applied Science (SEAS), Columbia University
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Columbia University in the City of New York (Morningside Heights & Manhattanville, New York, USA)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Physics & Applied Mathematics, Chemical Engineering, Earth & Environmental Engineering, and Data Science.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100% of admitted PhD students receive full multi-year fellowship packages (~450 to 550 doctoral awards annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally on merit; Pakistani scholars in computing, engineering, and data science regularly secure full Columbia doctoral funding (~4 to 7 awards annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full 5 years of doctoral study guaranteed
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: $45,000 to $48,500 / year (approx. $3,750 to $4,040 / month; ~PKR 1,040,000 to 1,120,000 / month) 12-month living stipend plus 100% full tuition waiver and comprehensive Columbia Health plan

nationality_requirements: Open to international students worldwide including Pakistan as well as U.S. citizens/PR
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction; selection based strictly on academic excellence and research potential.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 16-year Bachelor's or 18-year Master's degree with exceptional academic standing (equivalent to minimum GPA 3.80+ / 4.00 or top-decile rank) from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum undergraduate/graduate GPA of 3.8 / 4.0; admitted Columbia doctoral candidates are evaluated on research impact.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Computer science, electrical engineering, biomedical engineering, data science, mathematics, or physics.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year undergraduate/master's students completing degree before September.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior scientific research publications, conference presentations, or industrial software contributions strongly advantageous.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: TOEFL iBT minimum 100 or IELTS Academic minimum 7.5 mandatory for Columbia GSAS and SEAS.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must be admitted to a Columbia University PhD program.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Coordinated with Columbia standard multi-year doctoral funding guarantee.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full Columbia University doctoral tuition and required student facilities fees covered for all 5 years of study.

admission_application_fee.details: Columbia graduate application fee of $85 to $120; fee waivers available upon demonstration of financial need.
admission_application_fee.amount: $85 to $120 (~PKR 23,500 to 33,000) application fee (fee waiver available)

accommodation.details: Columbia University Residential housing in Morningside Heights, Manhattanville, or private NYC apartments funded via monthly living stipend.
accommodation.amount: Funded from stipend (~$1,300 to $1,900 / month rent in NYC)

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed 12-month living stipend of $45,000 to $48,500 / year ($3,750 to $4,040 / month; ~PKR 1,040,000 to 1,120,000 / month) disbursed semimonthly.

airfare.details: Relocation flights to New York City are self-funded or subsidized by departmental relocation allowances.

visa_fee.details: U.S. F-1 Student Visa application fee (~$185) and SEVIS I-901 fee (~$350) paid to U.S. government.

health_insurance.details: Columbia Student Health Plan (Aetna Student Health) and Morningside Columbia Health fee 100% covered for all doctoral fellows.

food_allowance.details: Dining and groceries covered through monthly living allowance.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Columbia University Libraries system (Butler Library, Science & Engineering Library), high-performance computing clusters (Habanero, Ginsburg), and laboratory infrastructure included.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: GSAS and departmental travel matching grants provide up to $2,000 to $3,500 per year for presenting research papers at conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Columbia Intercampus Shuttle is completely free connecting Morningside, Manhattanville, Medical Center, and Harlem rail stations.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single world-leading Ivy League research institution (Columbia University in the City of New York).
participating_institutions: Columbia University (Morningside Heights & Manhattanville Campuses, New York, NY, USA)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #34, U.S. News Top 15 National Universities; world-renowned for Computer Science, Data Science Institute, and Fu Foundation School of Engineering.
available_majors: PhD in Computer Science (AI, Vision, NLP, Systems, Security)
PhD in Applied Physics and Applied Mathematics
PhD in Earth and Environmental Engineering
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 5 years of full-time doctoral study and research
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree with 3.8+ GPA, verified transcripts, TOEFL 100+ or IELTS 7.5+, three academic letters of recommendation, CV detailing research outputs, and personal statement.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Columbia Computer Science and Data Science are intensely competitive (acceptance rate ~5%); demonstrating prior peer-reviewed research publications or strong technical contributions is crucial.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Articulate clear research synergy with specific Columbia faculty research groups and centers (e.g., Data Science Institute, Columbia Center for AI and Mental Health, Columbia Nano Initiative).

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Columbia Engineering / GSAS Online Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Columbia application portal, choose target PhD program, select faculty of interest, upload transcripts, personal statement, CV, test scores, and register 3 referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore Columbia faculty profiles and published papers in your field of interest.
Step 2: Obtain valid TOEFL iBT (100+) or IELTS Academic (7.5+) score report.
Step 3: Submit PhD application on Columbia application portal by December 15 deadline.
Step 4: Upload official academic transcripts, personal statement, and curriculum vitae.
Step 5: Three academic referees submit letters directly into the Columbia system.
Step 6: Departmental faculty admissions committee reviews applications and selects doctoral candidates.
Step 7: Successful applicants receive formal admission offer with full 5-year guaranteed funding package in February/March.
Step 8: Accept offer by April 15, receive I-20, and apply for U.S. F-1 Student Visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Universal Doctoral Funding: 100% of admitted Columbia PhD students receive full multi-year funding guarantees without separate financial aid application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via automated secure electronic appraisal forms.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Personal statement (approx. 1,000 words) describing academic trajectory, research questions, proposed methodologies, and alignment with Columbia faculty.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Incorporated into personal statement; publications or thesis samples uploaded under supplementary materials.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic research CV detailing education, publications, conference presentations, awards, and technical proficiencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Virtual technical interviews via Zoom with prospective faculty advisors evaluating research depth and theoretical foundation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: TOEFL iBT 100+ or IELTS 7.5+ mandatory; GRE optional/department-specific.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: $85 to $120 (approx. PKR 23,500 to 33,000; fee waiver available upon request)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Official HEC verified transcripts required upon final matriculation.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation of all non-English transcripts.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online submission via Columbia application portal.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual admission cycle for Fall entry; applications strictly due by mid-December.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 50% (Demonstrated research originality, peer-reviewed publications, technical problem solving)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Industry R&D lab experience or software engineering)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental Faculty Admissions Committees and Columbia Graduate School.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic review prioritizing research depth, originality, peer-reviewed outputs, and scientific match with Columbia research laboratories.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official Columbia website at columbia.edu.
Columbia never works with commercial recruiting agencies.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of $85 to $120 is paid directly through the secure portal; fee waivers are available for eligible applicants.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agencies cannot influence Columbia admissions; fraudulent applications result in permanent bans.
hidden_costs_breakdown: IELTS or TOEFL test fees: ~PKR 55,000 to 65,000.
Relocation flight to New York City: ~PKR 250,000 to 350,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Columbia doctoral students must pay tuition. Reality: 100% of admitted Columbia doctoral students receive full tuition coverage, health insurance, and a generous 12-month living stipend ($45k-$48.5k/yr).
Myth: You need a master's degree to apply. Reality: Students holding a 4-year Bachelor's degree are directly eligible to apply to Columbia PhD programs.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites frequently quote outdated stipend values; current verified Columbia 12-month doctoral stipend is $45,000 to $48,500.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic progress and minimum B+ (3.3/4.0) average in graduate coursework.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time resident study in New York City and active contribution to research laboratory projects.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews and doctoral qualifying exams administered by the department.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Teaching Assistant or Research Assistant duties are integrated into doctoral training; outside employment is restricted.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates are eligible for 3-year U.S. STEM OPT work authorization.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Obligation to fulfill designated departmental research or teaching duties.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminated if student withdraws or fails academic milestones.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from graduate program committee and faculty supervisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Full guaranteed funding for 5 years; dissertation completion support available for year 6.
